warning.titlePre: Mercedes S63 AMG Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your S63 AMG has the M157 engine (W221 or W222 generation), valve seal and coolant system wear is a known pattern on this twin-turbo V8. We replace valve seals and coolant system components as standard on every M157 rebuild.

If your S63 AMG has the M177 engine (W223 generation), valve seal and coolant system wear is also a known pattern, consistent with the broader AMG V8 family. We replace these as standard on every M177 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established AMG specialist pattern, per G-BRF and VRF-mercedes-s-class.md. Both codes are explicitly included in the claim
